steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json with the application name 'innovatehub' and project type 'web'.

steps.title: Configure Backend API Schema and Logic
steps.description: Set up api_schema.json with no backend as this is a client-side focused landing page, but include logic for the 'project_quote' calculation.

steps.title: Construct HTML5 Document Structure
steps.description: Create the foundational index.html with viewport settings, Tailwind CSS CDN, custom styles, and main script links.

steps.title: Implement Responsive Navigation Bar
steps.description: Design a sticky header with branding, desktop navigation links, and a mobile menu toggle.

steps.title: Create Dynamic Hero Section
steps.description: Build a hero banner with a compelling headline, descriptive text, and call-to-action buttons, featuring a dynamic image mosaic.

steps.title: Develop Core Features Section
steps.description: Add a section highlighting key services or features of InnovateHub, using a responsive grid layout.

steps.title: Implement Project Quote Calculator
steps.description: Integrate an interactive, client-side project cost estimator with dynamic inputs for service type, hours, complexity, and add-ons.

steps.title: Design Client Testimonials Section
steps.description: Showcase client feedback with cards featuring quotes and client details to build trust.

steps.title: Build a Contact / Inquiry Form
steps.description: Create a simple, client-side contact form with validation and a success message for user inquiries.

steps.title: Craft Footer Section
steps.description: Add a clean, informative footer with copyright information and navigation links.

steps.title: Apply Custom CSS Styling
steps.description: Create style.css for custom typography, active states, and minor visual enhancements beyond Tailwind defaults.

steps.title: Implement Interactive JavaScript Logic
steps.description: Develop script.js to handle mobile menu toggling, gallery filtering (if applicable), the project quote calculation, and contact form submission simulation.

steps.title: Building innovatehub
steps.description: Final review of the complete application for responsiveness, functionality, and adherence to design principles.
